business_summary: State Power Rixin Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of software and information technology services to the new energy industry in China and internationally. It operates through Energy Information Technology Sector and Integrated Energy Sector segments. The company offers single-station power prediction products, abnormal weather warning products, products and services related to the functional expansion of power prediction systems, centralized power prediction products, and regional power prediction products; automatic generation control system, automatic voltage control system, and new energy active support device; and new energy meteorological monitoring and forecasting, power grid new energy power forecasting and management, new energy intelligent consumption assessment, distributed management and prediction, power grid carrying capacity assessment, and smart load forecasting system. It also provides electricity trading data services, power trading decision support platform, and power trading hosting services; power generation side and grid side; energy storage cloud manager; microgrid energy management system; photovoltaic-storage-charging energy operation platform; and virtual power plant. State Power Rixin Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
